info.name: EDealer API
info.description: Multi-tenant SaaS API for vehicle dealers and RTO agents. Base URL uses {{baseUrl}}/api/v1.

request.description: Health-check endpoint for load balancers and monitoring.
Returns uploadUrl (PUT target), fileKey, and publicUrl. Run before 'Upload file (PUT raw)'.
PUT raw file bytes to the URL from Generate upload URL. Set body to a PNG file (or change Content-Type to image/jpeg / image/webp and pick a matching file). Max 5MB.
Create a new user. Sends 6-digit signup OTP to email. No access JWT until verify-otp (SIGNUP_EMAIL_VERIFICATION).

Authenticate with email and password. Returns user (dealerId from DealerWiseUser) and JWT. Access token payload includes dealerId (null if unlinked). dealerId is saved to collection variable when present. Dealer-scoped APIs use the token; optional dealerId in query/body must match the token for non-ADMIN users.
Exchange a valid refresh token for a new access token + rotated refresh token. No Authorization header. 4017 when the refresh token is invalid/expired/wrong-purpose.
Verify 6-digit OTP from email after register. Returns access JWT and user.
After forgot-password, verify 6-digit OTP. Saves resetToken for Reset Password request.
Re-send OTP. purpose: SIGNUP_EMAIL_VERIFICATION or PASSWORD_RESET.
Request password reset OTP (generic success message).
Set new password using Bearer resetToken from verify-otp (PASSWORD_RESET). Expires per JWT_PASSWORD_RESET_EXPIRES_IN.

Get WebAuthn registration options. Requires Bearer token. userId must match the authenticated user (JWT sub). Use response options in navigator.credentials.create(), then call Passkey Register Verify with the credential.
Verify WebAuthn registration response and store passkey. Body.credential is the object returned from navigator.credentials.create().
Get WebAuthn authentication options for passkey login. No auth required. Use response options in navigator.credentials.get(), then call Passkey Login Verify with the credential.
Verify WebAuthn authentication response. Returns user (same shape as password login: dealerId) and JWT.
Create a new RTO service.
List RTO services (paginated).
Update orderRank for multiple RTO services. Body: array of { serviceId, orderRank }; serviceName/shortName optional.
Get a single RTO service by ID. Set {{serviceId}} in collection variables (e.g. from Create response).
Update an existing RTO service by ID.
Delete an RTO service by ID.
categoryName, bothSide required; orderRank is max+1 server-side. Super-admin only.
Full list (no pagination); sorted by orderRank.
Replace categoryIds with real UUIDs. categoryName optional (ignored). Super-admin only.
Set uploadCategoryId (e.g. from Create).
categoryName, bothSide required. Super-admin only.
Delete by id. Super-admin only.
dealerId comes from JWT for normal users (optional dealerId in body for ADMIN only). uploadCategoryId unique per dealer. orderRank auto per dealer.
Uses dealerId from JWT (optional ?dealerId= for ADMIN). data: { dealerId, uploadCategory: [...] }.

item.name: List by dealer (view in step only)

request.description: Same as List by dealer but isViewInStep true only; each item includes bothSide from master UploadCategory. dealerId from JWT (optional query for ADMIN).
dealerId from JWT (optional in body for ADMIN). items[]. All dwucIds must belong to that dealer.
Path id is dwucId (DealerWiseUploadCategory PK).
Full body replace for mutable fields.
Delete by dwucId.
Each userId can only be linked once (single dealer for that user).
Creates a verified user (emailVerified=true) and links them to the dealer in one call. ADMIN must add "dealerId" to the body.
dealerId from JWT (optional ?dealerId= for ADMIN).
Path id is dwuId (DealerWiseUser PK).
Replace userId; dealerId unchanged.
Delete by dwuId.
Curated capability catalog for the FE checklist. Any authenticated dealer user.
{ isOwner, capabilities } resolved fresh for the caller. Any authenticated dealer user.
Dealer's roles with member counts. Gated by roles.manage (owner passes). Optional ?dealerId= for super-admin.
Create a role. Gated by roles.manage. capabilities[] must be catalog keys. Duplicate roleName -> 4090.
Update roleName and/or capabilities. Gated by roles.manage.
Set a dealer employee's roleId (roleId:null clears to the read-only default). Gated by roles.manage.
Delete a role. Members drop to the read-only default (roleId -> null). Gated by roles.manage.
Create a new dealer. emailId and whatsappNo must be unique.
List dealers (paginated).
Get a single dealer by ID.
Update an existing dealer. All fields required.
Delete a dealer by ID.
Super-admin only. Raise a dealer's active-agent cap (maxAgents). Provide exactly one of maxAgents | deltaSlots.
Super-admin toggles a dealer's isSubscribe (subscribed dealers get the dealer site + can be a connect target).

Super-admin pauses (isActive: false) or resumes (isActive: true) a dealer's access. While paused, the dealer's login users cannot sign in and live sessions get 403 / 4022 on every authenticated route. Returns { id, isActive }. Errors: 4038 not super-admin, 4043 dealer not found, 4220 invalid body/params.
Sync task-board statuses for the JWT dealer (optional dealerId in body for ADMIN only). Each item carries an isDone flag; array order sets statusRank.
Reorder task statuses for JWT dealer (optional dealerId for ADMIN). Body: { items: [{ statusId, statusRank }] }.
GET /dealer-task-statuses — task statuses for the dealer in the access token, ordered by statusRank.

item.name: Get Dealer Task Statuses By Dealer

request.description: Path dealerId must match JWT for non-ADMIN (ADMIN may use any dealer).
JWT dealer (optional dealerId for ADMIN). templateName unique per dealer.
Paginated list for JWT dealer, ordered by templateName asc (optional &dealerId= for ADMIN).

item.name: Get Dealer Task Template By ID

request.description: Get a single dealer task template by ID.
Update an existing dealer task template. templateName must remain unique per dealer.
Delete a dealer task template by ID.
List the resolved dealer's tags, ordered by tagName (agents/super-admin pass ?dealerId=). Returns a plain array.
JWT dealer (optional dealerId for agents/super-admin). tagName unique per dealer; duplicate -> 409 (4090).
Update a tag's name and/or colour. tagName must remain unique per dealer. 4069 not found; 4034/4039 tenancy.
Delete a tag by ID. ProcessTag join rows cascade. 4069 not found; 4034/4039 tenancy.
JWT dealer (optional dealerId for ADMIN). referenceName and referenceNumber unique per dealer.
All references for JWT dealer, no pagination (dropdown). Optional ?dealerId= for ADMIN.
Paginated list for JWT dealer (optional &dealerId= for ADMIN).
Get a single dealer reference by ID.
Update an existing dealer reference. referenceName and referenceNumber must remain unique per dealer.
Delete a dealer reference by ID.
Create vehicle. registrationNumber required & unique. chassisNumber/engineNumber unique when set; other fields optional null.
List vehicles (paginated).
Get a single vehicle by ID.

Per-vehicle buy/sell history for the caller's own dealership + an anonymized cross-dealer 'changed hands' signal. Dealer-scoped (super-admin/agent without a dealer -> 4033). 404 (4047) when the dealer has never handled the vehicle (not an existence oracle). registrationNumber is normalized server-side (case/spaces ignored).
Update vehicle. Same nullable rules as create.
Delete a vehicle by ID.
Create a new state. stateName is unique.
List states (paginated).
List all states for dropdown (no pagination).
Get a single state by ID.
Update an existing state.
Delete a state by ID.
Create a new city for a state. cityName is unique per state.
List cities (paginated). Optionally filter by stateId.
List all cities for dropdown for a specific state (no pagination).
Get a single city by ID.
Update an existing city.
Delete a city by ID.

One-shot start: upsert vehicle, create process, optional persons[], uploadPhotos[] (category+imageName), processReferences[] (referenceId+referenceType BUY|SELL), optional status (SOLD|COMPLETE|SCRAP, default null=OPEN) + dealNumber (<=100). dealerId from JWT. 4113 (one open per vehicle per dealer) only fires for an OPEN create.
Create a vehicle process and its persons in one request.

List vehicle processes (paginated). Each item includes persons, tags, and status (SOLD/COMPLETE/SCRAP or null=OPEN). Optional &search= filters by vehicle registration number (space/punctuation-insensitive) and any person's name (case-insensitive). Optional &tagId= narrows to a tag. Optional &status= one of SOLD|COMPLETE|SCRAP|OPEN (OPEN = status-less); AND-ed with search/tagId. Agents pass &dealerId= for a managed dealer.
Get a vehicle process by ID (includes persons).
One response: vehicle, owner (seller), buyer, references (SELL/BUY), photos with photoUrl.

Update a vehicle process. `persons` is OPTIONAL — omit it for a status- or price-only change and persons (incl. CANCELLED buyers kept for history) are left untouched; person management lives in the /persons endpoints (incl. change-buyer). When persons IS sent it is a full replace (non-empty, single seller/buyer). Omitted prices are nulled, so re-send prices to preserve them.

SOFT delete: moves the process to the recycle bin (sets deletedAt). The whole process is hidden from all active reads, but its children (persons, docs, photos, tasks, expenses, tags, references, comments, assignments) stay in the DB and return intact on restore. Permanently purged (hard cascade delete) 7 days after deletion (daily server sweep + lazy purge on bin view). A process already in the bin returns 4050.

Paginated recycle bin (soft-deleted processes), newest deletion first; viewing first lazily purges rows older than 7 days. Each item: { processId, registrationNumber, ownerName, deletedAt, purgeAt (deletedAt+7d), daysLeft }. Scope like the list endpoint: dealer sees own; agent passes &dealerId= (a managed dealer); super-admin sees all or &dealerId=.

Agent-scoped, agent-global. Caller agent's own recycle bin across ALL placeholder dealers they own (dealer.isPlaceholder && ownerAgentId === agent), newest deletion first; viewing first lazily purges rows older than 7 days. Same item shape as GET /vehicle-processes/bin: { processId, registrationNumber, ownerName, deletedAt, purgeAt (deletedAt+7d), daysLeft }. Non-agent callers get an empty paginated result. Restore/permanent by processId via the /restore and /permanent endpoints. Mirrors GET /vehicle-processes/agent-board.

Restore a soft-deleted process from the recycle bin (clears deletedAt). Its untouched children reappear whole. No-op if already active. Errors: 4050 not found; 4034 wrong dealer; 4039 agent does not manage this dealer.

PERMANENT hard delete: removes the process and cascade-deletes ALL its children immediately (active or already binned). Irreversible. After the DB delete, the process's whole per-process upload folder (uploads/{registration}_{processId}/) and every image under it are best-effort recursively deleted (a missing/undeletable folder never fails the delete). Errors: 4050 not found; 4034 wrong dealer; 4039 agent does not manage this dealer.

Bulk-restore soft-deleted processes from the recycle bin (multi-select). processIds: 1-100 process UUIDs. Two-pass for safety: every id is authorized first (fail-fast - if any is missing or unauthorized, nothing is changed), then each is restored. Response: { count }. Errors: 4220 invalid body; 4050 a process not found; 4034 wrong dealer; 4039 agent does not manage this dealer.

Bulk permanently hard-delete processes (multi-select). processIds: 1-100 process UUIDs. Cascade-deletes all children and best-effort deletes each process's upload folder (as DELETE :id/permanent does). Two-pass for safety: every id is authorized first (fail-fast - if any is missing or unauthorized, nothing is deleted), then each is permanently deleted. Response: { count }. Errors: 4220 invalid body; 4050 a process not found; 4034 wrong dealer; 4039 agent does not manage this dealer.

Agent-scoped. Caller agent's own (agent-created / placeholder-dealer) processes for the agent board, each with agent-kanban status, vehicle reg, source dealer, and tags ([{ tagId, tagName, colour }]). Pairs with GET /process-assignments/agent.

query.description: ISO datetime, inclusive lower bound on the date field; omit with dateTo for current-month default
ISO datetime, inclusive upper bound on the date field
processDate (default) | soldDate — which date column the range filters on
Comma-separated OPEN,SOLD,COMPLETE,SCRAP to include; empty/all = every status (OR-ed)
Managed-dealer passthrough (agent/super-admin); ignored for a dealer caller

request.description: Streams an Excel workbook or PDF of the caller's vehicle processes over a processDate range (current month when both dateFrom/dateTo are omitted), with only the selected sections. Binary attachment (not the JSON envelope). Dealer-scoped like GET /vehicle-processes. Stored WebP images are transcoded to JPEG and embedded (Excel: Documents/Vehicle Images sheets; PDF: image appendix). Capped at 500 processes; response headers X-Export-Count / X-Export-Truncated. In Postman use 'Send and Download' to save the file. Errors: 4220 invalid query; 4032/4033/4039/4226 dealer-scope.

item.name: Update Vehicle Process Agent Status (agent board)

request.description: Move an agent-created process into one of the owning agent's kanban columns (agent board). Updates agentStatusId only; the dealer-facing status string is untouched. 4234 if not an agent board process or the status is not the agent's.

Agent-only. Attach/replace the RTO receipt (PDF/image), first uploaded flat via /upload/generate + PUT. Server moves it into the process folder. Dealer can download it (receipt in details). 4063 if not the agent working this process.
Agent-only. Clear the RTO receipt (file left on disk). 4063 otherwise.
Agent-only. Set/clear the RC-book post/courier tracking number (blank clears). Dealer reads trackingNumber in details. 4063 otherwise.

Set/clear the fixed lifecycle status (SOLD/COMPLETE/SCRAP, or null to reopen=OPEN). Agent-aware scope (optional dealerId). A terminal value is always allowed; sending null is rejected (4113) when another OPEN process already exists for the vehicle under this dealer (at most one open process per vehicle per dealer). 4050 process not found; 4034/4039 tenancy.

Full-replace the process's tags (empty tagIds clears all). Every tag must belong to the process's dealer. Agent-aware scope (optional dealerId). Returns [{ tagId, tagName, colour }]. 4235 if a tag is not the dealer's; 4050 process not found; 4034/4039 tenancy.
Shared per-process comment thread (oldest first). Visible to the dealer owner and the assigned/managing agent.
Post a comment to a process's shared thread. authorUserId/authorRole are derived from the token.
Author-only edit of a comment body. 4062 if you are not the author.
Delete a comment. Author may delete their own; super-admin may delete any. 4062 otherwise.

Add a person to a vehicle process. dealerId from JWT; optional body dealerId for ADMIN. processId must belong to that dealer. Adding a BUYER while an ACTIVE buyer already exists returns 422 (code 4064) — use "Change Buyer" instead. Optional idImageName (an uploaded fileKey) is stored as the person's ID photo (category 'Buyer ID'/'Seller ID'), relocated into the process folder and linked to them so it shows in the process Documents.

Atomically cancel the process's current ACTIVE buyer (soft — kept for history with their ID photo) and add this new ACTIVE buyer. Optional buyerIdImageName (an uploaded fileKey) is linked to the new buyer as a 'Buyer ID' photo and relocated into the process folder. dealerId from JWT; optional body dealerId for ADMIN. Returns 201 with the new buyer.
List persons for processId (dealer-scoped). Optional &dealerId= for ADMIN.
Get one person. Optional ?dealerId= for ADMIN.
Full replace of mutable fields. Optional idImageName (an uploaded fileKey) REPLACES the person's linked ID photo (relocated + linked). Optional ?dealerId= for ADMIN.
Delete a person row. Optional ?dealerId= for ADMIN.

Single row: processId, category, imageName, optional kind (DOCUMENT|VEHICLE, default DOCUMENT). dealerId from JWT. The flat imageName is relocated into the process folder. kind=VEHICLE is capped at 5 per process (409 4114).
Free-form vehicle photo. Max 5 per process — the 6th returns 409 4114. Shown separately as data.vehiclePhotos on the process details endpoint.
Non-empty items[]. Each processId must belong to JWT dealer. Response data.items.
List photos for a vehicle process.
Get one row by processUploadPhotoId.
Replace the photo. A new imageName is relocated into the process folder and the OLD file's bytes are removed (best-effort). Same imageName = category-only update. kind is immutable.

Mark a VEHICLE-kind photo as the process's starred (primary/profile) photo. Atomically clears the star on every other vehicle photo (at most one starred per process). Only vehicle photos can be starred (409 4115 otherwise). No body.

Delete one row and best-effort remove the underlying file (unless another row references the same image key). If the deleted row was the starred vehicle photo, the oldest remaining vehicle photo is auto-promoted to starred.
taskName + taskDate required. assignUserId optional (omit or null for unassigned). status optional (max 50; defaults to To-Do).
List tasks for a vehicle process.

Dealer-wide task board across all processes. Returns open tasks plus tasks completed within the last 15 days. Optional filters: dealerId (ADMIN/managing agent), assignUserId, mine (true = the caller's tasks), status.

Dealer-wide completed-task history across all processes. All-time (not the 15-day board window), paginated, newest completion first. Optional filters: dealerId (ADMIN/managing agent), assignUserId, mine (true = the caller's tasks). A non-owner dealer user without tasks.viewAll is forced to mine=true.
Get one task by processTaskId.
Replace taskName, taskDate, assignUserId (null clears assignee), status (optional, max 50).
Delete a task row.
Shared per-task comment thread (oldest first). Visible to the dealer team (owner + employees) and the managing agent. Optional dealerId query for ADMIN / managing agent.
Post a comment to a task's shared thread. authorUserId/authorRole are derived from the token.
Author-only edit of a task comment body. 4062 if you are not the author.
Delete a task comment. Author may delete their own; super-admin may delete any. 4062 otherwise.
Expenses for one process (dealer-scoped, oldest first).
Book an expense against a process the caller owns. amount: positive, <=2 decimals. category optional.
A single expense the caller owns. 4060 when not found.
Update label / amount / category.
Delete an expense.
Create a role. roleName must be unique per typeId.
List roles for a tenant (typeId required). Optional roleType=DEALER|AGENT.
Get a role by roleId.
Update role (all body fields required).
Delete a role by id.
Modules with nested pages and actions for DEALER or AGENT.
Full replace for moduleType: create/update by moduleId; omit id to create; missing rows deleted.
Full replace under moduleId; set collection variable moduleId from catalog.
Full replace under pageId; set pageId from catalog.
Dealer/admin-facing. firmName, agentName, displayName required; contact fields optional and unique when set.
Creates a verified user (emailVerified=true) and links them to the agent in one call.
List agents (paginated).
Agent-scoped. The caller agent's own profile (resolved from the token). 4035 if the token is not linked to an agent.
Agent edits their own profile. isSubscribe is NOT accepted here (preserved server-side; super-admin's). 4035 if not an agent.
Get a single agent by agentId.
isSubscribe is required on update.
Delete an agent by agentId.
Super-admin toggles an agent's isSubscribe (subscribed agents can independently manage placeholder dealers' data).

Super-admin pauses (isActive: false) or resumes (isActive: true) an agent's access. While paused, the agent's login users cannot sign in and live sessions get 403 / 4022 on every authenticated route. Returns { id, isActive }. Errors: 4038 not super-admin, 4044 agent not found, 4220 invalid body/params.
Agent-scoped. agentId from JWT (ADMIN must add agentId). Each userId links to one agent only; a dealer-linked user is rejected (4097).
Creates a verified user and links them to the agent. agentId from JWT (ADMIN must add agentId).
agentId from JWT (optional ?agentId= for ADMIN).
Path id is awuId. Must belong to the caller's agent.
Replace userId; agentId unchanged.
Delete by awuId.
Agent-scoped sync (create/update/delete/reorder). agentId from JWT (ADMIN must add agentId). Array order sets statusRank.
Reorder only. All statusIds must belong to the agent.
Statuses for the agent in the JWT (non-admin).
Path agentId must match the JWT agent for non-admin.
Agent-scoped. Link a global upload category to the calling agent (agentId from JWT).
Full per-agent list.
Only isViewInStep=true (wizard checklist, includes bothSide).
Reorder the agent's links.
Single link by awucId.
Full replace of the link's flags.
Remove the link by awucId.
Dealer-scoped. Grants ACTIVE DEALER_GRANT access. Returns { grant, capInfo }; never blocked over cap.
Dealer's ACTIVE grants (each with agent summary) + capInfo. Returns { items, capInfo }.
Sets status REVOKED. Must belong to the calling dealer.
Dealer-scoped. Partial match on email/mobile/whatsapp/name/firm/display, excluding already-active grants. Min 2 chars.
Dealer-scoped. Old agent's OPEN assignments + ledger balance, previewed before a switch.
Dealer-scoped. Atomic: settle-or-keep ledger, complete OPEN assignments, revoke old grant, optionally grant replacement (cap-checked post-revoke).
Dealer-scoped. Invite a brand-new agent by email; emails a single-use onboarding link. Cap-enforced (4231).
Dealer-scoped. List the dealer's PENDING invitations.
Dealer-scoped. Regenerate token + expiry and re-send the email.
Dealer-scoped. Cancel a PENDING invitation (retained as CANCELLED).
PUBLIC. Validate token, return onboarding prefill.
PUBLIC. Create the agent account + login (auto-grant if a slot is free) and return a login bundle.
Dealer-scoped. Process must be owned by the dealer; the dealer must hold a live grant for the agent (else 4228).
Dealer-scoped. Non-cancelled assignments for a vehicle process (oldest first).
Dealer-scoped. Sets status CANCELLED. Must belong to the calling dealer.

Dealer-scoped. Paginated, newest first: the work the calling dealer has assigned to one agent. Each row: service, the agent's own status (agentStatus), the live ledger cost, and the source process (vehicle, lifecycle status, dealNumber, trackingNumber, hasReceipt, tags). Optional ?search= (registration number / make / model / service) and ?agentStatusId=<uuid|none>. 4044 when the dealer has never granted that agent.

Dealer-scoped. Totals for ALL the work the calling dealer has assigned to one agent: { agent, grantStatus, totals: { assignments, processes, costedAssignments, totalCost }, byStatus: [{ statusId|null, statusName, colour, count }] }. 4044 when the dealer has never granted that agent.
Agent-scoped. Caller agent's non-cancelled assignments (newest first). Each item's process carries tags ([{ tagId, tagName, colour }]). Optional ?dealerId= to filter by source dealer.
Agent-scoped. Returns { assignment, process (full detail), dealer }. Must belong to the caller agent.
Agent-scoped. Moves the assignment into one of the agent's own statuses (status must belong to the agent, else 4229).
Dealer-scoped. Set (positive) / remove (cost:null) / keep (omit cost) the agent cost in the ledger. Amount change => reversal + new entry; date/note-only => in-place.
Agent-scoped. Name-only dealer owned by the agent. dealerName/displayName default to firmName.
Agent-scoped. All placeholders owned by the calling agent (with connectedDealer summary).
Update name fields. All body fields optional.
Blocked (4093) when the placeholder has vehicle processes.
Connect to a real subscribed dealer (creates/reactivates a CONNECT grant). 4098 if target is not a subscribed real dealer.
Clears connectedDealerId and revokes the CONNECT grant when present.
Super-admin connects any agent's placeholder to a real subscribed dealer; migrates data + merges ledger.

Dual-persona: persona read from the token (agent token -> agent side, dealer token -> dealer side). Lists the caller's khata accounts (dealer -> one per agent; agent -> one per dealer), newest-updated first. Each account has a signed dealer-perspective balance (balance > 0 => dealer owes agent) plus a counterparty summary. 4059 if the token is not a dealer/agent account.

Running-balance statement for one dealer<->agent pair. counterpartyId is the agent id (dealer caller) or the dealer id (agent caller). data = { account|null, entries (newest first by seq), meta }. Reads do NOT require an active grant. 4220 if counterpartyId is not a UUID.

Post a credit/debit entry to the pair (caller + counterparty). Sign convention (dealer-perspective): CREDIT raises what the dealer owes the agent (+amount), DEBIT lowers it. direction is CREDIT|DEBIT; amount > 0, <= 2 decimal places. description and assignmentId optional. Requires an ACTIVE dealer<->agent grant (else 4054); an agent's placeholder dealer must be connected first (else 4057). Captures ledgerEntryId from the response. An optional assignmentId must belong to this same dealer↔agent pair (4236 otherwise).

Reverse an entry the caller is a party to: posts an opposite-direction counter-entry (originals are never hard-deleted) and stamps the original isReversed: true. data.entry is the reversal (reversesEntryId set). 4037 not a party, 4055 already reversed, 4056 cannot reverse a reversal, 4054 no active grant.

Post a balancing entry that drives the pair's balance toward zero. Send amount for a partial settle (capped at the outstanding balance); omit amount (send {} or no body) for a full settle. Requires an ACTIVE grant (4054). 4058 if already settled (balance is zero).
Upload a single image and extract readable text as strict JSON using Gemini.
Upload a single ID proof image (Aadhaar, PAN, DL, etc.). Returns fullName, address, city, state, pincode.

item.name: Registrations
item.description: Public self-registration (dealer/agent) -> super-admin approval. Public: register + verify OTP + /auth/me. Super-admin: list/approve/reject.

request.description: PUBLIC. Create a PENDING dealer/agent account (email unverified) and email a signup OTP. Then verify via /auth/verify-otp.
PUBLIC. Verify the emailed OTP -> marks email verified and returns a session (still PENDING approval).
AUTH. Fresh user + approvalStatus/approvalReason. Allowed even while pending; the pending screen polls this.
SUPER-ADMIN. Merged dealer+agent requests; default PENDING+REJECTED. Each item has kind (dealer|agent) + id.
SUPER-ADMIN. Approve ({{regKind}}=dealer|agent, {{regId}}=firm id) -> unlocks access; a dealer is also subscribed.
SUPER-ADMIN. Reject with an optional reason (emailed). Blocks access.
